meta.name: Kaleido Petals
meta.description: A kaleidoscopic flower: N triangle petals arranged in a ring, each rotated to point outward by u*tau plus an accumulating spin var. Petal length breathes with its own spectrum band, and a smoothed beat adds a tiny bloom to the petal length only (never a flash). A second, smaller inner ring counter-rotates for depth. Hue follows the petal angle plus a slow drift; additive blend makes the overlaps glow. Silence stills the spin and folds the petals to a calm small bud.
meta.author: ViewMusic built-in

element.x: (0.18 + 0.32 * (0.3 + 0.7 * band(u)) * smoothstep(0.02, 0.12, energy) + settings.bloom * bloomS) * cos(u * tau + spin) / aspect
element.y: (0.18 + 0.32 * (0.3 + 0.7 * band(u)) * smoothstep(0.02, 0.12, energy) + settings.bloom * bloomS) * sin(u * tau + spin)

color.h: u * settings.hueRange + drift * 30 + settings.tint_r * 120 + settings.tint_g * 240 + settings.tint_b * 360
